newsitem.title: BELARUS: Belarus munitions dump fire under control.
newsitem.headline: Belarus munitions dump fire under control.

text.p: Military firefighters have controlled a fire which broke out during the weekend at a munitions dump south of Minsk, the Belarus Defence Ministry said on Monday.
Ministry spokesmen said munitions experts were working to make safe shells and other ammunition at the dump near the village of Adamovo, 80 km (50 miles) south of Minsk.
They said the fire, which broke out on Saturday causing a series of explosions, had probably been caused by lightning.
A spokesman for Belarus's Emergency Situations Ministry, Alexander Zuyev, said one serviceman was injured trying to put out in the fire.
People earlier evacuated from their homes in the area were being allowed to return, he said.
